Introduction: Price and Performance
Thank you for purchasing an EVGA power supply.
The 430W/500W/600W is a premium quality power supply
that meets standard power protections to protect a safe and
reliable working environment. Designed for budget gaming or
casual media playback these EVGA power supplies are a great
choice to power your next project.

performance designs.
